radion production cross sections at LHC would greatly exceed that of the SM Higgs and that the radion to two photons decay mode can be used to probe the mass of the radion at Tevatron as well as LHC.
the production cross sections for light radion are enhanced over those for the SM higgs, and that the $\gamma \Gamma$ decay mode is an excellent channel for radion search.
the production of light stabilized radions at high energy hadronic colliders is enhanced by a factor of 7-8 over the production of SM higgs bosons.

the production of radion at high-energy hadron colliders and its detection via the decay into two photons.
